traits.name: Armor-Rending
traits.text: Any time the shuln scores a critical hit with a melee Strike, it also deals the same amount of damage to the target's armor, bypassing any Hardness lower than 10, like adamantine.

traits.name: Shuln Saliva
traits.text: (incapacitation, poison); Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and slowed 1 (1 round) Stage 2 3d6 (3d6) poison damage, and slowed 1 (1 round) Stage 3 4d6 (4d6) poison damage and paralyzed for 2d6 (2d6) hours. (null)

traits.name: Unstoppable Burrow
traits.text: Shulns can burrow into solid rock and any metal with a hardness less than that of adamantine like it is soil or loose rubble, leaving a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ adamantine claw +25 (agile, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d8+10 (3d8+10) slashing

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ adamantine fangs +25 (reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+10 (3d10+10) piercing plus shuln saliva
